monitor_reason: length: no sourced total length. Only verifiable source (armtorg.ru, reprint of Gazprom transgaz Ekaterinburg release dated 17 May 2021) states two strings DN500 and DN700 in Dombarovskoe LPUMG zone and a 40 km repair work zone on the first string (a repair-front, not the line length; 59 pipes/~600 m replaced). Tender chainage 'Du500 km 39.30-74.996' (etpgpb.ru) implies >=75 km for string 1N but the page could not be fetched (ConnectTimeout) so it is not cited; gazprom.ru/ekaterinburg-tr.gazprom.ru pages (Feb/May 2021 releases, Dombarovskoe LPUMG page) unreachable from this machine, no Wayback snapshots; interfax-russia behind servicepipe bot wall. A search-engine summary mentions a 36 km repaired section of the first string (unverified). OSM 114 km not a sourced length. Sponsor (Gazprom transgaz Ekaterinburg) and endpoints (Bukhara-Ural trunk to Orsk/Novotroitsk, Orenburg Oblast) are identified; operating line (1964 DN500 per seed note, not verified), so the add-threshold step leg is not the issue, the length leg is.
researcher_notes: Match check: no roster row. Closest are trunks P2289 Bukhara-Ural I, P5695 Bukhara-Ural II, P2298 Dombarovka-Orenburg (389 km, 1220 mm, different line); no existing row names Orsk or Novotroitsk, so not matched_existing. Likely a genuine uncaptured operating branch of two strings (DN500 + DN700); if a length >=25 km is later sourced (e.g. via the gazprom.ru May 2021 release or the etpgpb tender page from a machine that can reach them, or a Gazprom transgaz Ekaterinburg passport), promote to new_row; likely one row per string (DN500 and DN700 have different diameters) or one row with Diameter '500, 700' and segment note. Owner entity: entity_lookup.py takes no country arg; not run for a new entity since class is monitor. Tier medium (single source). Route: none researched; OSM way 'Otvod k GG Orsk-Novotroitsk' is a candidate geometry for a later route pass.
